`suse-cve-2026-98432.json` is a reduced excerpt of SUSE's [CVE-2026-98432 CSAF/VEX document](https://ftp.suse.com/pub/projects/security/csaf-vex/2026/cve-2026-98432.json), fetched November 3, 2026.
